integrity: All asymptotic statements are derived analytically from the exact boundary equations. Numerical exploration is not part of the proof.
limitations: The result refines the endpoint geometry of the explicitly known oscillatory interval; it does not add an existence/stability theorem and does not give amplitude or Floquet boundary asymptotics. Full text of one older continuous three-zone comparison was unavailable in a reliable form, leaving a small literature risk.
title: Two-scale endpoint geometry of a Filippov oscillatory wedge
